K/DA champions release new songs based on their total star level. At Combat Start and after 8 seconds, they gain power for each of their songs.

15 FIRESTARTER: Enemies take 12% max Health magic damage over 8 seconds.
21 GIRLS: K/DA members ascend to 4-star.
